task.title: Protect the site from abuse and runaway cost
task.description:
## Why
Anyone can type any username or league id. One script could spend the whole Sleeper budget or run up the bill.

## Steps
1. Limit report requests and username lookups per visitor.
2. Add Cloudflare Turnstile to the report request form.
3. Refuse new jobs with a "busy, try again shortly" message when the queue is longer than a set size.
4. Validate league and roster ids before any Sleeper call.

## Done when
- A script sending rapid requests is limited and other visitors are unaffected.
- A full queue returns the busy message instead of growing without bound.
